connector_idempotency_response_check.name: connector_idempotency_response_check
connector_idempotency_response_check.value:
(
        "connector_idempotency"."status" = 'pending'
        and "connector_idempotency"."response_status" is null
        and "connector_idempotency"."response_body" is null
      ) or (
        "connector_idempotency"."status" = 'stored'
        and "connector_idempotency"."response_status" is not null
        and "connector_idempotency"."response_body" is not null
      )

donation_disputes_cumulative_share_check.name: donation_disputes_cumulative_share_check
donation_disputes_cumulative_share_check.value:
"donation_disputes"."cumulative_share" IS NULL OR ("donation_disputes"."share" IS NOT NULL
        AND "donation_disputes"."cumulative_share" >= "donation_disputes"."share" AND "donation_disputes"."cumulative_share" <= 1)

dists_transfer_routed_check.name: dists_transfer_routed_check
dists_transfer_routed_check.value: "dists"."stripe_transfer_id" IS NULL OR "dists"."stripe_routed_to" IS NOT NULL

dists_settled_net_cut_check.name: dists_settled_net_cut_check
dists_settled_net_cut_check.value: "dists"."refunds_cut_share" IS NULL OR "dists"."settled_net" IS NOT NULL

generated.as: received_usd + fee_processing_usd + fee_dispute_usd - credited_back_usd - recovered_usd - written_off_usd

owed_amounts_write_off_check.name: owed_amounts_write_off_check
owed_amounts_write_off_check.value:
num_nonnulls("owed_amounts"."written_off_at", "owed_amounts"."write_off_reason", "owed_amounts"."written_off_by") IN (0, 3)
        AND ("owed_amounts"."written_off_usd" = 0 OR "owed_amounts"."written_off_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND btrim("owed_amounts"."write_off_reason") <> ''

loss_logs_write_off_check.name: loss_logs_write_off_check
loss_logs_write_off_check.value: CASE WHEN "loss_logs"."type" = 'write_off' THEN "loss_logs"."actor" IS NOT NULL ELSE "loss_logs"."dist_id" IS NOT NULL END

donation_takes_refund_check.name: donation_takes_refund_check
donation_takes_refund_check.value: "donation_takes"."kind" = 'dispute' OR ("donation_takes"."dispute_id" IS NULL AND "donation_takes"."chargeback_ref" IS NULL AND "donation_takes"."fee_usd" = 0)

public.v_campaign_total_usd.definition: SELECT campaign_id, COALESCE(SUM(net), 0) as total FROM (SELECT d.campaign_id as campaign_id, dists.net as net FROM donations d INNER JOIN dists ON dists.donation_id = d.id WHERE d.campaign_id IS NOT NULL AND dists.status = 'settled' UNION ALL SELECT c.id as campaign_id, dists.net as net FROM campaigns c INNER JOIN dists ON dists.fund_id = c.legacy_fund_id WHERE c.legacy_fund_id IS NOT NULL AND dists.status = 'settled') s GROUP BY campaign_id
public.v_campaign_total_usd.name: v_campaign_total_usd

public.v_contributions.definition: SELECT to_id as npo_id, COALESCE(SUM(amount_usd), 0) as total, COUNT(*) as count FROM dists WHERE status = 'settled' GROUP BY to_id
public.v_contributions.name: v_contributions

public.v_donation_total_usd.definition: SELECT fund_id, COALESCE(SUM(net), 0) as total FROM dists WHERE fund_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'settled' GROUP BY fund_id
public.v_donation_total_usd.name: v_donation_total_usd

public.v_loss_ltd.definition: SELECT npo_id, SUM(amount) as total FROM loss_logs GROUP BY npo_id
public.v_loss_ltd.name: v_loss_ltd

public.v_referrer_commissions_ltd.definition: SELECT COALESCE(referrer_user, referrer_npo) as referrer, npo_id, SUM(amount) as total FROM referrer_commissions WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY COALESCE(referrer_user, referrer_npo), npo_id
public.v_referrer_commissions_ltd.name: v_referrer_commissions_ltd

public.v_referrer_payout_ltd.definition: SELECT COALESCE(referrer_user, referrer_npo) as referrer, SUM(amount) as total FROM referrer_payouts WHERE error IS NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(referrer_user, referrer_npo)
public.v_referrer_payout_ltd.name: v_referrer_payout_ltd

public.v_rev_ltd.definition: SELECT npo_id, type, SUM(revenue) as total FROM rev_logs WHERE status = 'final' AND npo_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY npo_id, type
public.v_rev_ltd.name: v_rev_ltd
